title: Monitoring Diagnostics Toolkit
description: Original Python research software for equipment-specific monitoring from explicit SI sensor time series. Includes mass and heat balances, hydraulic resistance, RO permeability, valve tracking, chiller/heat-pump residuals, causal alarm policies, API documentation, development history and qualified validation records. Historical measured-data results are separated from simulation and reused development evaluation. External datasets, papers, fitted corpus profiles and upstream source checkouts are excluded. This is an alpha research toolkit; alarms do not establish fault causality or field safety qualification.
